LEARN VOID / DATA & BEHAVIOR

Composition

Build a type from smaller pieces of behavior.

Compose through using

using promotes selected members from a contained component. A component can be named explicitly, as in using motion: movement, or use its type name, as in using combat.

Keep the component’s semantics

The movement value copies with its containing value struct. The managed combat object retains shared identity. Composing the two does not turn a reference into a value or silently duplicate its state.

Follow the aliases

The player’s motion moves from 5 to 10. The two kit values have independent motion positions, 1 and 3, while both damage operations affect shared health, leaving 92. The result is 10 + 1 + 3 + 92 = 106.
